media_boundary.reason: The corpus is PDF-only. Synthetic cyber-response documents describe fictional systems and sanitized decision structures; the engine does not execute, validate, or infer any real operational cybersecurity technique.

sealed_record_twins.mapping_rule: Each page in every equal-page twin pair receives one record-unique stable logical anchor mapped to one public and one sealed physical anchor. Case, issue, disposition, and question resources may reference the stable logical anchor only.
sealed_record_twins.remaining_stable_anchor_id_template: For each disclosure page offset not listed above, use ca4m4.opengrid.anchor.stable.<disclosure-suffix>.page-<two-digit-one-based-offset>; listed semantic IDs replace the template ID at their exact offset.
sealed_record_twins.verification_rule: A session grant is per disclosure and exact resolved pack closure; revocation removes the sealed row and restores public projection. The sealed asset remains unresolved during public load and is path, size, digest, readability, and page-count verified from CAS on every authorized open before a leased snapshot is exposed.
